{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check arm distribution
print("Arm distribution:\n", df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check severity distribution by arm (to assess confounding)
print("Severity by arm:\n", pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))

# Confirm that the data has re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1 for same patient)
print("Number of patients with sample_seq > 1:", (df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max() > 1).sum())"}
